content:
elaine: quick sync — saw a support ticket where a tenant was blocked by a routing policy they didn't have visibility into. question: should route-level policies and telemetry be surfaced in the permissions preview in console?

sam: yes, we need visibility. operators expect to see which routes a role can hit. otherwise they misconfigure quotas.

matt: +1. but UX has to stay compact. we can't just dump a huge route list into every role modal. maybe an expandable per-route section? :thinking_face: 

karim: product perspective: customers ask for two things: 1) per-role route visibility and 2) per-role cost/latency delta when you toggle routing preferences (e.g., prefer-low-cost). telemetry ties into this.

juniper: from infra side we want to avoid leaking internal region names. we can show logical route groups (e.g., "low-latency", "gpu-fast", "cost-optimized") instead of underlying infra ids.

sam: agree on groups. also need a small API change: current /roles/:id returns allowed_actions but not allowed_routes. propose adding allowed_routes: ["low-latency","cost-optimized"] to the payload. simple patch.

matt: can you sketch the JSON?

sam: sure:

```json
{
  "role_id": "rol_123",
  "allowed_actions": ["deploy","read_routes"],
  "allowed_routes": ["low-latency","cost-optimized"],
  "route_quota_overrides": { "low-latency": "monthly:10M" }
}
```

elaine: nice. UX suggestion: permissions preview should show a compact table: Route | Allowed | Quota | Cost delta. default collapsed. clicking a route expands to show telemetry sparklines and recent fallbacks.

karim: telemetry note: we should display estimated cost delta per 100k tokens and a 90-day avg latency. engineers: do we have that in the telemetry pipeline today?

juniper: we have cost-per-route metrics (per-tenant aggregation) but not surfaced per-role. we can compute estimated cost delta for a role by summing route_cost * usage_profile; needs a job to map role->route usage. doable but 2 sprint effort.

sam: alternate lighter approach: show historical per-route cost and let admins eyeball. add an "Estimate for role" beta flag later.

matt: also a security concern: when previewing routes for cross-tenant roles (service accounts) make sure we don't expose other tenants' usage metrics. show only aggregated cost/latency for the tenant in scope.

elaine: agreed. action plan I'm proposing: 1) add allowed_routes to roles API (sam) 2) UI: compact collapsed route preview with group names (matt + devex) 3) telemetry: surface tenant-aggregated per-route metrics and add an opt-in "role estimate" job on a canary release (juniper) 4) perms audit: ensure no cross-tenant leakage (security review).

karim: timeline? customers asked for this for enterprise rollout next month. can we do a staged rollout?

sam: API patch in next PR today (backwards compatible). UI prototype in 1 week. telemetry canary in 3 weeks.

juniper: I'll scope loaner job for the estimate pipeline and write the privacy checklist.

devops-bot: deploy: role-api/patch-125 merged to staging by sam at 1755557999 :rocket:

elaine: thanks all. I'll put notes in the rollout doc and tag security for the checklist. :thumbsup:
